errors.text_span: The chart is divided into a total of ten slices, representing different categories.
errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate pie charts, not one chart with ten slices.

errors.text_span: Specifically, the slices represent "Existential" (green, 15.12%), "Quantifiers" (pink, 27.91%), "Limiter" (orange, 27.91%), "Negation" (yellow, 27.91%), "Universal Quantifiers" (blue, 29.07%), “Absolute” (yellow, 18.71%), “Absence” (orange, 18.71%), “Approximate Quantities” (green, 45.03%), "Comparative Relationships" (blue, 36.26%), and "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" (pink, 50.49%).
errors.evidence: Several labels are misassigned across the three pies. For example, in the left pie the labels are Existential Quantifiers, Negation, Universal Quantifiers, and Limiter; the middle pie has Approximate Quantities, Comparative Relationships, and Absolute Absence; the right pie has Disjunctive and Conjunctive. The description combines and misplaces these labels, including a non-existent label 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive'.

errors.text_span: The slices are colored in shades of green, blue, yellow, orange, and pink.
errors.evidence: The colors are not mapped correctly to the categories as described. The figure uses pastel colors: e.g., Existential Quantifiers is light green, Negation is peach/orange, Universal Quantifiers is light blue-gray, Limiter is light pink; the middle pie uses pale yellow, blue, and lavender; the right pie uses light blue-lavender and pink-lavender.

errors.text_span: The segments representing "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" and "Approximate Quantities" are visually offset from the center of the pie chart.
errors.evidence: Only the rightmost and middle pies are slightly separated as whole charts in the layout; there is no evidence that these are exploded/offset slices within a single pie. The individual slices themselves are not exploded.

errors.text_span: The slices, with the exception of “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” appear to be ordered by decreasing size, moving clockwise.
errors.evidence: This is not supported by the figure. The three separate pies do not present a single clockwise ordering by decreasing size, and the right pie is not a multi-slice ordered chart.

The prompt requires description of chart structure and visible labels; because this is a pie-chart figure with multiple panels, the description omits the panel-level organization and overall captioned distinction between Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive.
The description does not clearly identify that there are three separate pie charts/panels with their own titles, which is a key visible structural feature requested by the prompt.
